executable.description: Absolute Claude/Codex executable path, or absolute Node executable path with one launcher script argument.

args.description: Only one absolute .js/.mjs/.cjs launcher path is allowed, and executable must be Node. Provider flags cannot override bridge safety controls.

endpoint.description: Full API endpoint. HTTPS required except explicit loopback custom servers. No credentials, query, fragment, or redirects. A built-in provider must keep its official origin.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name only. Never place the credential value in this config.
